task.title: Make default sync tip-focused and bounded
task.description: Remove exhaustive semantic history replay from default fetch, push, and sync. Trust histories produced by Workbook and synchronously validate only owned non-symbolic task refs; tip commit, tree, operation.json, and complete state.json structure; canonical format and project, task, and generation identity; local and remote ancestry; divergence; and CAS or non-fast-forward safety. Make a fresh checkout expose correct current task state from validated tips without replaying historical checkpoints. Use one fetch, batched ref and tip inspection, no per-task ls-remote, and one non-atomic push or another constant bounded number of pushes while retaining per-ref outcomes and partial success. Skip publication entirely when already synchronized. Preserve isolated tracking refs, never touch code refs, and document that default sync does not detect buried semantic checkpoint inconsistencies; workbook validate owns that audit. After implementation, run every benchmark from the topology harness exactly once and report results against the approved targets without tuning or replacement runs.
